startup.postgres_version: PostgreSQL 17.2 on aarch64-unknown-linux-musl, compiled by gcc (Alpine 14.2.0) 14.2.0, 64-bit

fast.reasoning: fast probe: 500 ms poll, 300 ms statement_timeout. Query touches pg_locks + pg_stat_activity + pg_class + pg_namespace only, no per-row functions; expected < 30 ms even under M3 freeze. 500 ms cadence chosen to give >= 18 samples inside M3's 9 s descent. Recalibrate from results/<runId>.locks.probe.csv (rows where probe_kind = 'fast') after first real M3 run.

slow.reasoning: slow probe: 2 s poll, 1500 ms statement_timeout. Query includes pg_blocking_pids(l.pid) which is evaluated per lock row and gets expensive under contention. Conservative pre-calibration. Recalibrate from results/<runId>.locks.probe.csv (rows where probe_kind = 'slow') after first real M3 run.
